name: Canvas LMS
description: Polls Canvas LMS for assignments, deadlines, and announcements. Surfaces urgent items to Jarvis via TaskFlow.

apiUrl.description: Your Canvas institution URL, e.g. https://canvas.university.edu

apiToken.description: Canvas API access token (generate in Canvas > Account > Settings > New Access Token)

sessionKey.description: OpenClaw session key to deliver Canvas notifications to

deadlineWarningHours.description: Hours before a deadline to surface a Q1 alert (default: 48)

pollIntervalMinutes.description: How often to poll Canvas in minutes (default: 15)
